messages.subject: Help in RSNNS using
parts:
Hi dear,
I please you to help me for solving a problem in application of RSNNS package in context of neural network academic project. 
Indeed, I have to apply Lenvenberg Marquardt algorithm as learning function in this package but I don't know how to do it. 
Additionally, any help to use this algorithm for neural network is welcome.
Best regard.

messages.author: 47597751d567aea1
messages.subject: Re: Help in RSNNS using
parts:
Hi,

I don't think this is implemented in RSNNS. You can check yourself here:

http://www.ra.cs.uni-tuebingen.de/SNNS/UserManual/UserManual.html

The closest to what you want is probably the SCG, or the simulated annealing.

Regards,
Christoph
